description: This file defines the ClaimController class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system, specifically for the claims plugin module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up the claim event component during pre-rendering.

classes.name: ClaimController
classes.description: Controller for handling claim-related views and actions in the OrangeHRM claims plugin, utilizing Vue components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component 'claim-event' before rendering the claim view.
